520.title: Add due dates to invoices
520.body:
## Problem

Invoices have no due date.

## Scope

Compute a due date in `app/billing/invoice.ts`.

## Verification

- A unit test shows a due date 30 days after issue.

521.title: Add a memo to invoices
521.body:
## Problem

Customers want a note on each invoice.

## Scope

Add an `invoices.memo` column and model field.

## Verification

- A migration test adds and drops the column.

522.title: Store a customer tax ID
522.body:
## Problem

EU customers must show a VAT number.

## Scope

Add a `customers.tax_id` column and model field.

## Verification

- A migration test adds and drops the column.

525.title: Show the invoice due date on the PDF
525.body:
## Problem

The PDF omits the due date.

## Scope

Render the due date from `app/billing/invoice.ts` on the invoice PDF.

## Verification

- A snapshot test shows the due date on the PDF.

526.title: Settings: let customers choose a time zone
526.body:
## Problem

Times show in UTC.

## Scope

Add a time zone select to `app/views/settings.tsx`.

## Verification

- A component test saves a chosen time zone.

527.title: Pagination drops the last invoice on the final page
527.body:
## Problem

`pageBounds` returns an inclusive end.

## Scope

Return an exclusive end from `pageBounds` in `app/lib/pagination.ts`.

## Verification

- A unit test shows page 2 of 15 invoices ending at 15.

531.diff:

diff --git a/db/0042.test.ts b/db/0042.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1111111
--- /dev/null
+++ b/db/0042.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+import { migrateUp, migrateDown, columns } from "./harness";
+
+test("adds invoices.memo", async () => { await migrateUp("0042"); expect(await columns("invoices")).toContain("memo"); });
+test("drops invoices.memo", async () => { await migrateDown("0042"); expect(await columns("invoices")).not.toContain("memo"); });
+test("memo is nullable", async () => { await migrateUp("0042"); expect(await columns("invoices", { nullable: true })).toContain("memo"); });

files.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- The canonical tracker is GitHub issues in acme/ledger-app, configured in `.agents/managing-issues.json`.
- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.
